description:
## 1.3.0-dev.1

- docs: clean up CHANGELOG — remove bump commits, stable releases show all dev changes
- feat: raise toolbar max to 15 via Gboard's own preference
- fix: release changelog only shows the bump commit, not the actual changes
- feat: spoof getPackageName() on LatinApp to restore GMS/Phenotype features
- fix: disable swipe-length scaling and hide its slider
- docs: note the glyphs.py fix in the roadmap icon audit entry
- fix: glyphs.py tail check bleeding into the next path, skipping filled icons
- feat: enable grammar check, smart replies, and keep suggestion strip on
- feat: generalize flick symbols into a 'Suggested Settings' patch
